content.short: UltraYield, created by Edge Capital, offers market-neutral yield vaults with institutional-grade strategies.
content.description: UltraYield was created by the crypto hedge fund Edge Capital to make its yield strategies available as on-chain vaults. It focuses on market-neutral strategies, which aim to earn yield without taking a directional view on price. On Plasma it operates as a risk curator for the vaults it manages.
